Record Class CustomerProfileRecord

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
app.record.CustomerProfileRecord
Record Components:
userId - the trader, the auth service's user id
firstName - given name
lastName - family name
traderLevel - BEGINNER, INTERMEDIATE or ADVANCED
availableFunds - the trader's cash as of asOf
sessionTimeoutMinutes - minutes of inactivity before the trader is signed out
lastActivityAt - when the trader was last active, or null
createdAt - when the profile was created
asOf - when this state was read; a consumer keeps the funds of the newest state it has seen
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlatformRecord
public record CustomerProfileRecord(UUID userId, String firstName, String lastName, String traderLevel, BigDecimal availableFunds, Integer sessionTimeoutMinutes, OffsetDateTime lastActivityAt, OffsetDateTime createdAt, OffsetDateTime asOf) extends Record implements PlatformRecord
A trader's profile, published as "CUSTOMER_PROFILE" when the profile is created. It carries the name, the level reporting segments clients by and the cash balance; the SSN, address, date of birth and middle name stay in the database.
